prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: review-only modular character anatomy/style board for Caelum Argenteum, issue #736 under #458. This is concept artwork, not evidence of a native 3D model.
Primary request: one clean landscape comparison board showing exactly six full-body standing adult figures of CAELITH. Top row: same adult male in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK. Bottom row: same adult female in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK. Orthographic-like views, identical scale within each row, full heads and soles visible, relaxed neutral stance with arms slightly away from the torso. Believable anatomy and joints, ordinary capable physiques, no exaggerated superhero or childlike proportions.
Style and presentation: closely match reference image 1's polished restrained 3D character concept rendering, plain light gray studio background, soft neutral light, fine cloth/leather textures and clear consistent view layout. Image 1 is only the proposed human board for shared clothing/material/lighting/layout; it must not erase the species anatomy in the other references.
Clothing: male and female wear the same practical plain ivory/cream long-sleeved lace-collar shirt, loose dark charcoal trousers, simple brown leather belt, separate brown leather gloves and calf boots as image 1. Fully covering, modest fit. Each garment must read as a separate removable layer; hair, if applicable, is not built into the shirt. No armor, cape, scarf, jewelry, weapons, shields, new accessories or environment. No numeric heights or gameplay claims.
Species requirements: Reference images 2 and 3 are the owned male and female Caelith head atlases. Preserve their individual faces, long pointed ears, angular cheekbones and established humanoid anatomy. Both have the referenced green skin and separate silver-white swept hair; the green example is only one of the already required red/green/blue skin options, and the white hair is only an example among the six required independent hair colors. Preserve the male's longer swept layered hair and the female's shorter swept cut exactly in spirit, showing the ears and rear silhouette. No horns, wings, tail, tusks, tattoos, glowing eyes or extra anatomy. Adult male/female bodies in the common plain outfit, slightly refined natural silhouettes, not exaggerated thinness or sexualization. Skin must not recolor clothes or hair.
Layout and exact text: title "CAELITH / STYLE PROPOSAL"; subtitle "Concept only - pending author review"; row labels "MALE" and "FEMALE"; each row's column labels "FRONT", "PROFILE", "BACK". No other text. Generous spacing, crisp detail, no clipped body parts. Preserve each individual, clothing, color, head shape and hairstyle across its three views.
